newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa nears recent highs.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa nears recent highs.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa approached recent highs in Tuesday's morning session but fell short of resistance levels after opening broadly up, traders said.
Active December was 16 stg up at 1,066 stg a tonne after trading between 1,068 and 1,058, just short of its recent high of 1,069.
First month September was up 17 at a session-high of 1,037. It opened nine stg up at 1,029 and traded between 1,037 and 1,029 -- just below its August 12 high of 1,039 stg.
March rose 17 to 1,087 after trading between 1,088 and 1,079.
The morning's volume was 4,154, well up on recent trading. Traders said about 1,000 of this was crosses plus about 400 switches.
"It's quite good volume," a trader said.
A key day reversal on Monday when the market opened lower but closed higher brought in fund short covering on Tuesday and sparked the rise, a trader said.
"It started going up on technicals because of yesterday which triggered fund buying. So we're close to recent highs and waiting for New York," he said.
Technical analysts said earlier cocoa futures were likely to continue Monday's upward momentum with September gearing up for a test of resistance at 1,039.
Broker GNI said the market was getting into buy territory.
